description: Given a public GitHub owner and repository name, discover the repository owner from repository metadata and return that owner's current follower count.
Given a city name, geocode it and return the current temperature in Celsius for the resolved coordinates.
Given an ISO alpha-2 country code, obtain the capital coordinates from country metadata and return the current temperature in Celsius at those coordinates.
Given an ISO alpha-2 country code, discover its first official currency code and return the latest USD quote for one unit of that currency.
Given a city name, geocode it to a country code, read that country's metadata, and return the first official currency code.
Given an npm package name, discover its repository URL from npm metadata, normalize the URL path using allowed transforms, read the GitHub repository owner, and return that owner's follower count.
Send an email to an arbitrary recipient with supplied subject and body.
Insert an arbitrary row into a PostgreSQL table.
